messages:
dana: Kicking off staggered region rollout — US -> EU -> APAC. Plan: US full, EU warm to 30% then evaluate, APAC on hold until EU steady. Need capacity sanity check before EU ramps.

deploy-bot: :rocket: Release 1.12.0 starting. us-slice: shifting traffic now (target 100% in 2m). Canary checks: us-canary-1 OK, us-canary-2 OK.

lee: Observing a small bump in queue length for the text-gen pool in us-west-2 during the ramp, but tail latencies holding ~220ms p99. Nothing alarming.

maria: EU warm nodes booted. eu-warm-1 reports higher KV cache miss rate (12% -> 18%) right after model shard load. Might be cold cache effect.

deploy-bot: [metrics] us-slice: avg latency 58ms, p95 140ms, p99 225ms. Throughput nominal. eu-slice (10%): avg latency 65ms, p99 260ms.

lee: Noting intermittent 500s from eu-hot-2 at 11:46 — stack shows OOM attempt to allocate new kv cache chunk. I restarted the container; it's back. Posting logs: ```ERROR oom: cannot allocate 1.2G for kv-cache```

maria: Thanks — that explains the cache miss spike. eu-hot-2 restarted and rejoined. We bumped the cache retention to avoid immediate re-eviction.

sre-oncall: GPU temps stable (avg 68C), utilization 70-78%. No infra throttles. Disk IO within normal.

dana: Good. Given the eu-hot-2 restart and cache warm-up, keep EU at 30% for another 10m and re-evaluate. Do NOT start APAC until EU p99 < 280ms for 5m.

ops-bot: Rollout policy updated: eu-slice -> target 30% now; apac-slice pinned at 0% pending EU pass. Auto-rollback rule: if eu p99 > 300ms for 3 consecutive minutes, revert to v1.11.

lee: Running a quick stress check on eu warm pool: synthetic load + prefix caching enabled. Monitoring results look stable so far.

deploy-bot: Canary stability window reached for US. US -> marked green. EU at 30% for 7m. APAC still on hold per pin.

maria: Adding note to release notes: "EU saw transient KV-cache evictions during warm-up; mitigated by cache retention tuning. No customer-facing errors observed."

dana: Decision: Keep EU at 30% for another 6m. If p99 stays under 280ms and error-rate <0.1% we'll proceed to APAC warm (10%). If EU regresses, trigger rollback to v1.11 and notify customers.

sre-oncall: Set alert: eu p99 > 280ms for 2m -> paging. Also added a soft alarm at 250ms for ops watch.

lee: Copy. I'll keep an eye on KV eviction metrics and surface any node-level anomalies.

ops-bot: Reminder: change window ends in 2h30m. If APAC warm doesn't start within the window, we'll reschedule for next window.

dana: Thanks team. Triage channel = #incidents if anything spikes. I'll post final go/no-go for APAC after the 6m observe window. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Update: eu-slice p99 trend: 235ms -> 240ms -> 238ms over last 3 mins. No rollback triggered.

maria: All green from my side. Proceeding to prep APAC warm once you give the go.

dana: Go for APAC warm in 2m. Keep EU pinned to 30% until APAC metrics look stable.

deploy-bot: APAC warm starting: apac-slice -> 10% target. Canaries: apac-canary-1 initializing.

sre-oncall: Monitoring apac GPU temps — nodes spiking to 74C under initial load but within safe thresholds.

lee: Observed apac p95 ~160ms, p99 ~310ms for first minute (cold). Expect to come down as cache warms.

maria: Noting one 502 from apac-canary-1 at 12:15 due to short-lived model load failure, retried automatically. No user impact.

dana: Hold pattern: if APAC p99 > 350ms or error-rate >0.2% for 2m, rollback APAC warm and escalate. Otherwise we'll step APAC to 30% in 10m.

deploy-bot: Final: US steady, EU stable at 30%, APAC warm at 10% with warming signals improving. No rollbacks executed. Release 1.12.0 marked: staged-region-rollout-complete -> partial (US/EU/APAC warm).
